questions.stem:
The probability that it rains on Monday is 0.3.

If it rains on Monday, the probability that it rains on Tuesday is 0.6.

If it does not rain on Monday, the probability that it rains on Tuesday is 0.2.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that it rains on both days.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that it rains on exactly one of the two days.
partial: M1 for the sum of both products

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the probability that it does not rain on either day.

questions.stem: A four-sided spinner is spun 200 times. The results are shown in the table.$$\begin{array}{l|cccc} \text{Number} & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline \text{Frequency} & 46 & 58 & 44 & 52 \end{array}$$

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the relative frequency of the spinner landing on 2.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: The spinner is spun 1000 times. Estimate the number of times it lands on 4.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Do the results suggest the spinner is biased? Give a reason for your answer.
parts.answer: No — each frequency is close to the expected 50
partial: B1 for no with a correct reason

questions.stem: A box contains 4 black beads and 6 white beads. Two beads are taken at random, **without replacement**.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that both beads are black.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that one bead of each colour is taken.
